主题：2026 Compliance Handbook - Final Version
COMPLIANCE HANDBOOK 2026

Section 1: Purpose
This handbook outlines company-wide compliance training requirements and enforcement procedures for all employees.

Section 2: Training Categories
All employees must complete: Information Security, Anti-Harassment, and Data Privacy training annually.

Section 3: Scheduling
Training sessions are scheduled quarterly. Employees receive calendar invitations 30 days before their due date.

Section 4: Completion Tracking
All training completions are logged in the central training tracker with timestamps and certificate IDs.

Section 5: Reminders
Automated reminders are sent at 14 days and 7 days before due date.

Section 6: Enforcement Actions
Overdue employees are handled as follows:
- 1 to 14 days overdue: Send a warning email to the employee and CC their manager.
- 15 to 30 days overdue: Suspend the employee's system access. Email IT (it-security@company.example.com) requesting access suspension and email the employee's manager.
- Over 30 days overdue: Escalate to the compliance committee (compliance-committee@company.example.com). Do NOT take direct action.
The compliance committee receives only over-30-day escalations; do not CC or otherwise notify it for 1-to-30-day warning or suspension cases.
IMPORTANT: Employees with an active exemption in the Notes field are excluded from enforcement regardless of overdue status.

Section 7: Reporting
Monthly compliance reports are filed with the board.

Section 8: Amendments
This handbook is reviewed annually."}
